messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The project has a larger rules folder. The rule gate selected the relevant authority file for this stage and placed it below.
This file overrides any character names that seem natural from the brief:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: Mara plots a course into the ruined city.
scenes.visual_description: A windswept hill at dusk overlooking a shattered royal city; ink-stained coat flapping, brass compass spinning wildly, a parchment map weighted by stones.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp flickers a first warning.
scenes.visual_description: A close-up of an oil lamp on a stone wall; the flame holds a single glowing eye that stares toward the castle gates in the distance.

scenes.caption: Tin fox scampers ahead to scout the gates.
scenes.visual_description: A small clockwork fox with a key-wind tail and blue glass eyes darting along the cracked cobblestones beneath looming, half-collapsed castle gates.

scenes.caption: Glass diver emerges from a tall broken window.
scenes.visual_description: A figure in a clear diving helmet steps out of a shattered stained-glass window as if surfacing from water, coat catching reflections of broken neon-blue city lights.

scenes.caption: The team gathers beneath a torn royal banner.
scenes.visual_description: A frayed crimson banner sags across an alley; four figures huddle below it studying the map, the oracle lamp casting a warm orange circle on the stones.

scenes.caption: A cursed tower looms, humming with old magic.
scenes.visual_description: A leaning black tower wreathed in pale green mist; runes glow faintly along its base while the tin fox sniffs at a scorch mark on the ground.

scenes.caption: Rumor of a great winged beast above the rooftops.
scenes.visual_description: Silhouettes on a rooftop pointing at a vast shadow sliding across the moon; scales and a long tail just visible through smoke, but no creature shown clearly.

scenes.caption: An armored patrol clanks down the avenue.
scenes.visual_description: From a low alley angle, dented steel boots and pike-shafts march past a puddle; the tin fox crouches behind a barrel, eyes glowing dim to hide.

scenes.caption: The sleeping tax collector blocks a key doorway.
scenes.visual_description: A plump official slumped on a stoop, ledger book under his head as a pillow, stamped papers stuck to his sleeves; a heavy oak door stands shut behind him.

scenes.caption: Mara forges a stamped pass from his own papers.
scenes.visual_description: Close-up of ink-stained fingers carefully peeling a wax-sealed pass off the dozing official's sleeve; the tin fox holds an inkpot in its jaws.

scenes.caption: Oracle lamp warns of a deceitful magic door.
scenes.visual_description: An ornate door covered in shifting silver sigils; the lamp's single eye narrows, casting a warning red glow across the diver's reflective coat.

scenes.caption: Glass diver slips through a tall mirror instead.
scenes.visual_description: A cracked floor-length mirror ripples like water as the diver plunges in headfirst, coat trailing shards of reflected lamplight.

scenes.caption: Inside the keep, the captive is found at last.
scenes.visual_description: A dim stone chamber lit by the oracle lamp's beam; chains hang from a chair, and Mara's gloved hand reaches toward a small bundled figure off-frame.

scenes.caption: Tin fox triggers a clockwork distraction.
scenes.visual_description: The metal fox winds its own tail and launches a cascade of bells and gears down a spiral stair; sparks bounce off ancient mosaic tiles.

scenes.caption: Frightened townsfolk peer from shuttered windows.
scenes.visual_description: Narrow stone street lined with shuttered windows where pale faces and small lanterns peek out; Mara presses a finger to her lips as the team hurries past.

scenes.caption: An armored patrol blocks the route to the bridge.
scenes.visual_description: A line of polished helms across a plaza ahead; the diver crouches behind a fountain while the oracle lamp dims its flame to a thin orange thread.

scenes.caption: They sprint across the cracked stone bridge.
scenes.visual_description: A long arched bridge over a churning black river; the team runs full tilt, the tin fox out front, banners and arrows flying past them in motion blur.

scenes.caption: Safe on the far shore, the lamp winks out one eye.
scenes.visual_description: Dawn light on a misty riverbank; the team rests against a milestone, the rescued bundle wrapped in Mara's coat as the oracle lamp's flame slowly closes its eye in relief.
